name: Circuit Lab
desc: An RC charging-circuit lab: resistance, capacitance and supply sliders drive the exponential charge curve, with time constant, charge and stored energy shown live.
controls: Resistance, capacitance and supply-voltage sliders, four presets (fast/medium/slow/huge), charge/discharge buttons, curves toggle; keys 1–4 load presets, Space charges, D discharges
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
